about.title: What is DevFest Yaoundé?
about.body: DevFest is Google's global series of developer-led, community events — and DevFest Yaoundé is our local chapter's flagship gathering, run by GDG Yaoundé for the people building things in and around this city. Expect real talks from real practitioners, hallway conversations that turn into collaborations, and a room full of people who'd rather be here than anywhere else.

wallTerms.title: Community wall terms
wallTerms.metaDesc: What we store when you save a DevFest card, how long it stays, and how to take it down.
wallTerms.lead: Short version: we keep a smaller copy of the composed card, not the photo from your camera roll, and you can take it down any time.
wallTerms.storedBody: When you download, share or copy a card, we save a smaller JPEG of the composed card (about 640px), the display name you typed, the time, the style, and the wording of the notice you were shown. The original photo never leaves your device. No GPS, no camera serial — it is drawn on a canvas and re-encoded here.
wallTerms.whereBody: On the public Community Wall, unless you take it down or an organiser hides it. The wall is not offered to search engines.
wallTerms.howTitle: How to take a card down
wallTerms.howBody: Write gdgyaounde@gmail.com and say which nickname or which picture. There is no button on the wall — an organiser will hide or delete it.
wallTerms.children: Do not put a card of a child on the wall. If you see one, write gdgyaounde@gmail.com.

wallRemove.empty: Nothing saved on this browser. If you made a card on another phone, write the chapter and tell us which one.
wallRemove.failed: That didn't work. Try again, or write the chapter.

cfs.openTitle: Got something to share? Take the stage.
cfs.openBody: The lineup is not written yet — it is waiting for you. Whatever you have been building, debugging at 2am or arguing about in group chats, somebody in this room wants to hear it. First talk counts; you do not need a conference badge collection to submit one.
cfs.waitingBody: Start thinking about what you would talk about — submissions open shortly, and we would rather you had the idea ready than the form.
cfs.closedTitle: Submissions are closed. Lineup coming soon.
cfs.closedBody: Thank you to everyone who sent something in — there was a lot of it, and it is being read properly. The speakers will be announced here first.
cfs.bannerOpen: The call for speakers is open — got something to share? Take the stage.
cfs.banner: The call for speakers is open — the DevFest Yaoundé 2026 stage is waiting for your talk.
